source_notes: GEM FIDYear=2025 reflected a Nov-2024 Reuters report that Petrosen expected FID in 2025. Following Kosmos Energy's withdrawal (joint withdrawal agreement announced 23 Apr 2026, no compensation; license to be reassigned exclusively to Petrosen subject to ministerial decree), Petrosen now targets FID for 2026 (MSGBC, 4 May 2026: 'Final Investment Decision targeted for 2026'). Widely reported as a December 2026 deadline. FIDStatus remains Pre-FID. Yellow: target/deadline via reported official statements, not a regulatory FID filing; date could slip.

GEM LatestPlannedStartYear=2026 is no longer attainable: FID is not expected until 2026, so a 2026 start is impossible. Post-Kosmos-exit, first gas is targeted for 2028-2029 (MSGBC, 4 May 2026: 'First gas expected between 2028 and 2029'); the recurring specific figure across reporting is 'first gas January 2029'. Set latest planned start to 2029. OriginalPlannedStartYear (2026) left unchanged as the original plan. Yellow: target via reported officials for a pre-FID deepwater project; likely to move further.
